titles.english: Final Fantasy XIV: CHOOSE YOUR LIFE
titles.native: ファイナルファンタジーXIV - CHOOSE YOUR LIFE

description:
Final Fantasy XIV: CHOOSE YOUR LIFE are a series of short anime commercials promoting the release of Final Fantasy XIV: Shadowbringers.

In this world, you can become anything. A hero, a treasure hunter, a mahjong master, even an influencer. Endless content and possibilities await. That’s what Final Fantasy XIV is—a place of infinite potential.
